classification_categories.power_calc: Formal a priori power calculation (α, β, effect size specified)
classification_categories.effect_size_estimate: Quantitative estimate from pilot/literature, no formal calc
classification_categories.replication_standard: Appeal to field convention or replication of prior study
classification_categories.resource_constraint: Sample size limited by availability, budget, or cohort size
classification_categories.methodology_determined: Sample size inherently defined by measurement technique or study design (stereology, cryo-EM, single-molecule imaging, complete-specimen census); no separate determination step expected
classification_categories.no_justification: n stated but no reasoning provided
classification_categories.na_or_blank: Field empty, N/A, or not applicable
classification_categories.ambiguous: Text present but insufficient to classify

records.title: TSC tunes progenitor balance and upper-layer neuron generation in neocortex
records.sample_size_raw: A priori sample size calculations were not performed. For experiments using human tissues, we included as many different samples (n=3) as we were able to obtain. For others, minimum sample sizes were estimated based on previously published studies (PMID: 31277925; PMID: 31846650).

records.title: Spatiotemporal cellular map of the developing human reproductive tract
records.sample_size_raw: No sample size calculation was performed, sample size was determined by the time availability to collect samples. - scRNA-seq: 73 fetal donors; - scATAC-seq: 29 fetal donors; - 10x Visium: 20 fetal donors, 1 adult donor; - In Situ Sequencing: 9 fetal donors. The sample size is sufficient as we have representation of all post-conception weeks between 6 and 21 in at least one technology. For the majority of stages, we have used multiple technologies to profile the samples. This is the largest study of its kind in the field of developmental reproductive biology

records.title: Human assembloids recapitulate periportal liver tissue in vitro
records.sample_size_raw: No statistical methods were used to estimate sample sizes before the study. We based our sample numbers on a combination of previous experience with in vivo and in vitro systems, and standards in the field.
